about_the_game:
"

G.I. JOE Roleplaying Game Operation Cold Iron Adventure

Picking up where Emerald Oubliette leaves off, this four-part adventure takes 3-6 G.I. JOE characters from level 2 all the way up to level 6.  This world trotting adventure takes your squad from the fiery deserts of Addis Ababa to the frozen plateaus of Siberia. Get behind the wheel of classic G.I. JOE vehicles like the Polar Battle Bear and the Snow Cat, facing off against iconic Cobra tech like the H.I.S.S. Tank and S.N.A.K.E. Armor. "
